ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this module. Used as a fallback accessibility label when the section has no visible heading.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used for #anchor-links on the page. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the documentation cards. HTML is allowed.

SectionHeadingElement.helper: Choose the heading level that fits the page outline.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Short intro shown below the heading. HTML is allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Access product specifications, integration guides, and implementation resources.

SectionAriaLabel.helper: Optional. Used only when no visible section heading is provided.

Documents.helper: Add documentation cards in display order. CTAs render only when CTA Text and the selected source resolve to a safe URL.

Description.helper: Optional. Short supporting description for this document.
Description.placeholder: Complete endpoint reference with authentication, payload examples, and response formats.

FileSource.helper: Choose whether this document links to a typed URL or a selected/uploaded file.

Url.helper: Allowed URL formats: anchors, slash-relative URLs, http, https, mailto, and tel.

UploadFile.helper: Select or upload the real document file. Type and size are computed when OpenContent file metadata or a safe local file lookup is available.

FileTypeLabel.helper: URL mode only. Optional fallback when the URL has no file extension.

FileMeta.helper: URL mode only. Optional manual type and size fallback when the template cannot compute them from the URL.

IconClass.helper: Optional. Font Awesome icon class. Only letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, and spaces are rendered.

FooterLabel.helper: Optional. Small footer label shown before the CTA.

CtaText.helper: CTA link text. The CTA renders only when this and the selected source resolves to a safe URL.

LinkTarget.helper: Choose whether the CTA opens in the current tab or a new tab.

CtaAriaLabel.helper: Optional. More descriptive label for screen readers, especially when CTA text repeats across cards.
